name: Paper Dart
idea: The X of CNX is drawn by a coral paper dart flying across a folded indigo paper strip, so the last letter of the name is literally your parcel in flight.
why: A paper plane that is also a letter is a two-second story anyone can retell, and the coral dart crossing the indigo fold stays recognisable from a van side down to a favicon.
risks: Paper planes are the universal "send" icon, so the dart must always appear as part of the X and never alone, and the overshooting nose needs extra clear space in tight layouts.
